text:
Type: glass-door cabinet with panel doors
Use: displaying dishes and books, storing linens behind lower panels; dining room, living room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: solid wood with a stained finish, glass upper door panes, wooden lower door panels, metal knobs
Colors: warm red-brown, dark grey knobs
Shape: tall upright cabinet with two doors, glass panes above framed wooden panels below, inner shelves, small round knobs, flat top, short square legs, solid and stately, heavy visual weight
Feel: warm, rustic, homey, cozy
Goes with: white or cream walls, natural textiles, wrought iron accents; farmhouse, country or traditional dining rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Solid wood has a natural feel.
